text.tspan: S1 EPS power path and inhibits (SQSO-EPS-BRD-001)
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · dashed = part not selected · values from the board build-to designs
Sources: hardware/electrical/eps/design.py (netlist, refs), EPS_BOARD_DESIGN.md 4-7; docs/BASELINE_PARAMETERS.md 4-5; CDS 2.3.7, 2.3.8
F1 heater: Q20 (EOL_FIRE) in series with
Q21 (EOL_ARM latch U61): two OBC lines
INHIBIT DS2: Q6+Q7 BUK9Y4R4-40E back to back (blocks charge and discharge)
gate from BAT_F via 10 k, DS2 NC contact (J16), RBF pole A (J14), 1.2 M / 1.0 M, 47 nF
Q23 wakes the AFE (TS2) when DS2 is released
each from its own switch on its own rail (J15-J17):
DS1 -> Q4 high side in PACK_P (pack and array)
DS2 -> Q6/Q7 in the pack return (pack)
DS3 -> Q5 high side in VB1, and TRK_EN low (pack and array)
Each switch drives a gate through >= 23 ms RC; no switch
carries bus current. RBF (J14): pole A opens DS2's drive,
pole B holds TRK_EN low (not counted).
Stowed drain 2.2 uA typ, 6.7 uA worst (AFE in SHUTDOWN).
Umbilical J13: charge into PACK_P via F5, D16; return PACK_N.
